title: Antigravity model-tier pruning + server-authoritative UI model lists
context: User: new antigravity flash 3.8 model appeared; model lists were overlong everywhere ("hard to find anything") and pruning only applied to claude. Wanted pruning + new model on New session dialog, f2 Continue-new, and ccc models.
decision: Extended server-side model pruning to antigravity: new _prune_antigravity_models_to_latest_tiers (with _antigravity_model_generation parser) in server.py, wired into _build_engine_model_catalog right after the claude pruner. Policy: family = (brand, tier) parsed from labels like "Gemini 3.5 Pro (High)" and raw ids like "gemini-3.1-pro-preview"; keep highest version per family, force-keep the generation hosting the engine default, keep all effort variants of kept generations. Result: antigravity catalog 18 -> 9 models (3.5 Pro H/M/L, 3.5 Flash H/M, 3.8 Flash H, Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.6 Thinking, GPT-OSS 120B). Also changed static/app.js _mergeModelOptionsForEngine: a non-empty server catalog list now REPLACES MODEL_OPTIONS_BY_ENGINE[engine] (server is source of truth) instead of union-merging — union kept stale static entries alive on every picker (New session dialog, spawn defaults, f2 Continue-new, Simple home) after server-side pruning. Empty/absent server list keeps union fallback. Static fallback antigravity list updated to the pruned 9 incl. Gemini 3.8 Flash (High). Committed 2dbbabab (not pushed). ccc CLI engine-column follow-up from dec_638f150a33 was already shipped in 9a88b4d0 — no change needed.
consequences: Server-side pruning is now the single authority; UI pickers mirror it automatically via replace-merge
Future new antigravity generations prune automatically by version parse; the configured default's generation is never dropped
Old models no longer in any list are still spawnable as custom models where supports_custom=true
alternatives_rejected: Client-side only pruning (would drift from server catalog and ccc CLI)
